title: Stop Buying Bedrock Models by Token Price: Agents Lose on the Long Walk

items.claim: AWS’s “new framing” for choosing OpenAI models on Amazon Bedrock
items.note: The source supports AWS’s framing and the Bedrock/OpenAI context, but the available excerpt provides no publication date or other evidence that it is new.

items.claim: AWS says its open-source benchmarking harness measures cost per correct answer, agent trajectory cost, and rubric-graded deliverable quality.
items.note: This matches the source excerpt exactly in substance.

items.claim: The definition of “correct,” trajectory-cost components, rubric details, experimental design, model list, sample size, results, and reproducibility artifacts are not independently confirmed or disclosed in the available material.
items.note: These are appropriately scoped absence and hedge statements about the available evidence package, which contains only the source excerpt.

items.claim: AWS has not established an industry standard, and the available evidence does not show independent validation of outcome-based, trajectory-aware comparisons.
items.note: Properly phrased as limits of the available evidence, not as a definitive claim about all external research.

claim_check.reason: The core AWS and harness claims match the supplied source, and the article carefully labels unverified details as unavailable or single-source. The unsupported event-specific assertion is that AWS’s framing is “new.”

evidence_caveats: 缺少 AWS 原文中的发布日期、harness 源码链接、实验设计、样本量、模型名单与结果表，无法审计评测是否可复现。
缺少展示“低单价但长轨迹导致更高任务成本”的具体实验或真实生产案例。
缺少独立来源对 outcome-based、trajectory-aware 模型评测的交叉验证。
交付物 rubric 的规则、评委/模型、评分一致性及其与可上线性的关系未知。
缺少反例或冲突报道，无法界定该框架在哪些低复杂度、单轮或固定输出任务中不适用。
现有直接来源虽标记为 fetched，但仅提供截断摘要；页面全文与时间线仍未核验。
seo_title: Stop Buying Bedrock Models by Token Price
seo_summary: Cheap tokens can hide expensive agent failures. Measure correct answers, trajectory cost, and deliverable quality—not just rates.
